name: Kono Oozora ni, Tsubasa o Hirogete
original_name: この大空に、翼をひろげて
source:
Aoi returned to his hometown of Kazegaura where a gentle breeze blows through the streets, having lost his direction in life. On the hill lined with windmills, he met a wheelchair-ridden girl Kotori and watched the gliders overhead in awe. With his childhood friend Ageha in tow, they resurrect the soaring club in order to fulfill a childhood dream: to fly on a glider.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/05/01/may-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
水濑碧迷失了人生方向，回到微风吹过街道的故乡风浦。在一座布满风车的山丘上，他遇见坐轮椅的少女羽羽音小鸟，两人惊叹地仰望从头顶飞过的滑翔机。随后，碧与青梅竹马姬城扬羽一同重建翱翔社，只为实现童年梦想：驾驶滑翔机飞上天空。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/05/01/may-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
